{{NintendoService |name=Nintendo Anime Channel |logo=[[File:Nintendo Anime Channel logo.png|frameless|center|225px]] |caption=Nintendo Anime Channel logo |provider=Nintendo |launched='''Europe:''' February 13, 2015
'''AU & NZ:''' February 14, 2015 |shutdown=October 31, 2018 |serviceprovided=Nintendo anime video on demand |accessableby=[[Nintendo 3DS]] |externallink=[https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Nintendo-3DS-Family/Download-Content/Nintendo-Anime-Channel/Nintendo-Anime-Channel-947961.html Nintendo UK official website] }} '''Nintendo Anime Channel''' was a free app for the [[Nintendo 3DS]] family of systems available from the [[Nintendo eShop]], that provided access to a selection of {{wp|anime}} based on [[Nintendo]] properties as well as other licensed series. The service was first announced during the January 14, 2015 [[Nintendo Direct]][https://www.nintendo.co.uk/News/Nintendo-Direct/2015/Nintendo-Direct-January-14th-2015/Nintendo-Direct-January-14th-2015-980865.html ''Nintendo Direct – January 14th, 2015'' - Nintendo UK] (retrieved February 24, 2021) and launched in Europe on February 13, 2015[https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2015/01/nintendo_anime_channel_will_bring_free_streamed_shows_to_3ds_in_europe ''Nintendo Anime Channel Will Bring Free Streamed Shows to 3DS in Europe'' - Nintendo Life] (retrieved February 24, 2021) and in {{pmin|Australia}} & {{pmin|New Zealand}} on February 14, 2015[https://web.archive.org/web/20150125135514/https://www.nintendo.com.au/index.php?action=news&nid=3587&pageID=6 ''The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D And Monster Hunter 4 Ultimate Coming 14th February'' - Nintendo Australia] (archived from the original January 25, 2015; retrieved February 24, 2021). The app launched with a selection of episodes from [[Pokémon the Series|Pokémon]], {{wp|Kirby: Right Back at Ya!|Kirby}} and {{wp|Inazuma Eleven (TV series)|Inazuma Eleven}}, with the intention that the library of content would grow over time. Episodes from [[S07|season seven]] of the TV show were added from August 2015[https://twitter.com/NintendoEurope/status/633326525811695616 ''Nintendo of Europe'' - Twitter] (retrieved February 24, 2021) and episodes from [[S08|season eight]] were added in May 2017[https://nintendo-insider.com/pokemon-advanced-battle-now-available-on-nintendo-anime-channel/ ''Pokémon Advanced Battle Now Available On Nintendo Anime Channel'' - Nintendo Insider] (retrieved February 24, 2021). The service closed on October 31, 2018[https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Nintendo-3DS-Family/Download-Content/Nintendo-Anime-Channel/Nintendo-Anime-Channel-947961.html ''Nintendo Anime Channel'' - Nintendo UK] (retrieved February 24, 2021){{dead link}}. ==Available Pokémon animation== At the time of the service closure, the following series of [[Pokémon animation]] were available on the service: * Certain seasons of {{aniseries|PTS}}: ** [[S01|Indigo League]] (season 1) ** [[S02|Adventures on the Orange Islands]] (season 2) ** [[S06|Advanced]] (season 6) ** [[S07|Advanced Challenge]] (season 7) ** [[S08|Advanced Battle]] (season 8) * [[Pokémon Generations]] ==Trailer== {{youtubevid|qu2lPPSMAb4|Nintendo3DSuk|Omega Ruby|Alpha Sapphire}} ==References== {{bulbanews|Nintendo Anime Channel coming to Nintendo 3DS in Europe, Australia, New Zealand}} {{reflist}} ==Related articles== {{VOD}} {{Project Mass Media notice}} [[Category:Service]] [[Category:Defunct services]] [[Category:Nintendo 3DS games]] [[Category:TV and VOD]] [[de:Nintendo Anime Channel]] [[it:Nintendo Anime Channel]]
